answer: Make every identity maintain a distinct, ongoing exchange with each peer it has attested: a lone island keeps a few honest conversations, but a farm of twenty copies owes one hundred ninety pairwise threads across the canyon, each needing fresh, peer-specific substance. Reused scripts fail the uniqueness check, and the burden grows with the square of the farm — like a ridge that steepens with every step — until running copies costs more attention than the rewards return.
